achievements.requirementSummary: Finish the opening battle and reach Black Wind Mountain.
guideSteps: Complete the tutorial duel with Erlang and continue through the opening scenes.
The achievement registers automatically when the Destined One begins the journey.
achievements.routeHint: Finish the opening battle and reach Black Wind Mountain.

achievements.requirementSummary: Craft any piece of armor at a Keeper's Shrine.
guideSteps: Advance until shrine armor crafting becomes available.
Open Craft Armor, choose any affordable unlocked piece, and forge it.
achievements.routeHint: Craft any piece of armor at a Keeper's Shrine.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Lingxuzi in Guanyin Temple.
guideSteps: Follow the Forest of Wolves route to Guanyin Temple.
Defeat Lingxuzi; this is a required story encounter.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Lingxuzi in Guanyin Temple.

achievements.requirementSummary: Absorb your first Yaoguai Spirit with the Blessed Gourd.
prerequisites: Receive the Blessed Gourd guidance from the old master on the Bamboo Grove route.
guideSteps: Defeat a spirit-dropping Yaoguai Chief.
Interact with the blue flame left behind to absorb its Spirit.
achievements.routeHint: Absorb your first Yaoguai Spirit with the Blessed Gourd.

achievements.requirementSummary: Equip any soak in a drink at a Keeper's Shrine.
guideSteps: Obtain a soak, then choose Brew at a Keeper's Shrine.
Select the drink, place the soak in an open slot, and confirm the brew.
achievements.routeHint: Equip any soak in a drink at a Keeper's Shrine.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Whiteclad Noble in the Marsh of White Mist.
guideSteps: Continue through Bamboo Grove to Marsh of White Mist.
Win both phases of the Whiteclad Noble fight.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Whiteclad Noble in the Marsh of White Mist.

achievements.requirementSummary: Craft any weapon at a Keeper's Shrine.
guideSteps: Defeat bosses until a staff upgrade unlocks in shrine crafting.
Gather its materials and Will, then forge the weapon.
achievements.routeHint: Craft any weapon at a Keeper's Shrine.

achievements.requirementSummary: Ring all three great bells in Chapter 1.
prerequisites: Explore the side arenas near Guangzhi, Guangmou, and Whiteclad Noble.
guideSteps: Ring the bell behind Guangzhi at Forest of Wolves - Outside the Forest.
Ring the bell behind Guangmou at Bamboo Grove - Snake Trail.
Ring the bell beyond Whiteclad Noble at Marsh of White Mist.
achievements.routeHint: Ring all three great bells in Chapter 1.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Elder Jinchi in the Ancient Guanyin Temple secret area.
prerequisites: Ring all three Chapter 1 bells.
guideSteps: The third bell transports you to Ancient Guanyin Temple.
Rest at the shrine, loot the area, and defeat Elder Jinchi.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Elder Jinchi in the Ancient Guanyin Temple secret area.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Black Bear Guai and finish Chapter 1.
guideSteps: Climb Black Wind Mountain after defeating Black Wind King.
Use the Fireproof Mantle if needed, then defeat Black Bear Guai.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Black Bear Guai and finish Chapter 1.

achievements.requirementSummary: Craft any mortal medicine after learning medicine crafting.
prerequisites: Meet Xu Dog below Crouching Tiger Temple and complete his first request.
guideSteps: Open Make Medicines at a Keeper's Shrine or speak with Xu Dog.
Craft any available consumable formula.
achievements.routeHint: Craft any mortal medicine after learning medicine crafting.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat the royal rat family encounters in Sandgate Village.
guideSteps: Fight the King of Flowing Sands and the Second Rat Prince at Sandgate Village.
Continue into the valley and defeat the First Rat Prince.
guideChecklist: King of Flowing Sands and Second Rat Prince
achievements.routeHint: Defeat the royal rat family encounters in Sandgate Village.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Red Loong behind the Chapter 1 waterfall.
prerequisites: Obtain Loong Scales from the hidden wall in Chapter 2's First Rat Prince arena.
guideSteps: Travel back to Forest of Wolves - Outside the Forest.
Follow the waterfall route, use Loong Scales to enter, and defeat Red Loong.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Red Loong behind the Chapter 1 waterfall.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete the Man-in-Stone quest in Fright Cliff.
guideSteps: Find Man-in-Stone in the ravine near Squall Hideout and exhaust his dialogue.
Defeat Mother of Stones, return the Stone Essence, then defeat Man-in-Stone.
Rest and return so his merchant inventory becomes available.
guideChecklist: Return Stone Essence and win the duel
achievements.routeHint: Complete the Man-in-Stone quest in Fright Cliff.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Black Loong behind the Chapter 2 sandfall.
prerequisites: Obtain Loong Scales from the First Rat Prince arena.
guideSteps: Travel to Fright Cliff - Rockrest Flat and find the sandfall.
Use Loong Scales to open the arena and defeat Black Loong.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Black Loong behind the Chapter 2 sandfall.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Stone Vanguard at Rockrest Flat.
guideSteps: Explore Fright Cliff and reach the Stone Vanguard arena.
Defeat Stone Vanguard to receive the key item needed for story progression.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Stone Vanguard at Rockrest Flat.

achievements.requirementSummary: Collect six Buddha's Eyeballs and use them to awaken Shigandang.
guideSteps: Collect all six glowing Buddha heads around Squall Hideout and Rockrest Flat.
Place the Eyeballs at the large stone beside the Stone Vanguard arena.
Defeat Shigandang when it awakens.
guideChecklist: Eyeballs placed at the arena stone
achievements.routeHint: Collect six Buddha's Eyeballs and use them to awaken Shigandang.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Fuban in the Kingdom of Sahali secret area.
prerequisites: Complete the Yellow-Robed Squire's drunken boar quest to enter Sahali.
guideSteps: Advance through the Kingdom of Sahali and defeat its Tiger Vanguard.
Speak with the Yellow Wind Sage, enter the desert arena, and defeat Fuban.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Fuban in the Kingdom of Sahali secret area.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete the Yellow-Robed Squire quest and enter the Kingdom of Sahali.
guideSteps: Give the drunken boar a Sobering Stone near Rockrest Flat.
Speak to him at Crouching Tiger Temple and give him a Jade Lotus.
Return to his first location, defeat the Yellow-Robed Squire, and follow him through the gate.
achievements.routeHint: Complete the Yellow-Robed Squire quest and enter the Kingdom of Sahali.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat all three Tiger Vanguard family encounters in Chapter 2.
guideSteps: Defeat Tiger Vanguard at Crouching Tiger Temple.
Defeat the earlier Tiger Vanguard in the Kingdom of Sahali.
Use the Old Rattle-Drum route to find and defeat Mad Tiger.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat all three Tiger Vanguard family encounters in Chapter 2.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete the Old Rattle-Drum quest and defeat Mad Tiger.
prerequisites: Defeat Tiger's Acolyte and obtain the Old Rattle-Drum.
guideSteps: Use the drum at each of the three child-voice locations in Yellow Wind Ridge.
Follow the child into the well in Sandgate Village and defeat Mad Tiger.
guideChecklist: Sandgate Village drum spot and well
achievements.routeHint: Complete the Old Rattle-Drum quest and defeat Mad Tiger.

achievements.requirementSummary: Craft your first Celestial Medicine with Xu Dog.
prerequisites: Defeat Tiger Vanguard and find Xu Dog in the Crouching Tiger Temple cellar.
guideSteps: Give Xu Dog a Mind Core in the cellar or Zodiac Village.
Choose a permanent Health, Mana, Stamina, or resistance upgrade and craft it.
achievements.routeHint: Craft your first Celestial Medicine with Xu Dog.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Yellow Wind Sage and finish Chapter 2.
guideSteps: Open the gate with the key items from Stone Vanguard and Tiger Vanguard.
Equip Wind Tamer for an easier final phase, then defeat Yellow Wind Sage.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Yellow Wind Sage and finish Chapter 2.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete the two-headed rat prisoner's quest and obtain Ashen Slumber.
prerequisites: Exhaust the two-headed rat NPC dialogue in Chapter 2's Sandgate Village.
guideSteps: Speak with the hidden two-headed rat survivor in Sandgate Village until dialogue repeats.
In Chapter 3, inspect the prison cell beside the Lower Pagoda starting cell.
Follow the quest outcome to obtain the Ashen Slumber transformation.
achievements.routeHint: Complete the two-headed rat prisoner's quest and obtain Ashen Slumber.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Captain Wise-Voice in Pagoda Realm.
guideSteps: Climb from Lower Pagoda to Mani Wheel.
Before the fight, finish the nine Lantern Wardens if you want their missable Curio.
Defeat Captain Wise-Voice to end the Pagoda curse.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Captain Wise-Voice in Pagoda Realm.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Kang-Jin Star at Turtle Island.
guideSteps: Continue across the frozen lake and Pagoda route to Turtle Island.
Defeat Kang-Jin Star to continue toward Bitter Lake.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Kang-Jin Star at Turtle Island.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Cyan Loong on Turtle Island.
prerequisites: Obtain Loong Scales in Chapter 2.
guideSteps: From Turtle Island shrine, descend to the lone fisherman-like figure at the island edge.
Approach with Loong Scales and defeat Cyan Loong.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Cyan Loong on Turtle Island.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Apramana Bat and collect Turtle Tear on the North Shore of Bitter Lake.
achievements.missableNote: Apramana Bat can disappear after the Chapter 3 story advances too far. Do this on the first North Shore visit with Zhu Bajie.
guideSteps: From North Shore of the Bitter Lake, follow the right-hand coast while Zhu Bajie accompanies you.
Inspect the giant snake skeleton and defeat Apramana Bat.
Interact with the giant turtle's tear on the shore; the Turtle Tear soak is also needed later.
guideChecklist: Apramana Bat defeated before it disappears
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Apramana Bat and collect Turtle Tear on the North Shore of Bitter Lake.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete Chen Loong's request and unlock Zodiac Village.
prerequisites: Reach North Shore of the Bitter Lake and have access to Xu Dog.
guideSteps: Defeat Chen Loong in the water near North Shore of the Bitter Lake.
Ask Xu Dog for the special medicine and deliver it to Chen Loong.
Use the Ruyi Scroll he gives you to enter Zodiac Village.
achievements.routeHint: Complete Chen Loong's request and unlock Zodiac Village.

achievements.requirementSummary: Upgrade any armor piece with Yin Tiger.
prerequisites: Unlock Zodiac Village through Chen Loong's quest.
guideSteps: Speak with Yin Tiger at the village forge.
Choose Upgrade Armor and improve any eligible piece by one rarity tier.
achievements.routeHint: Upgrade any armor piece with Yin Tiger.

achievements.requirementSummary: Challenge and defeat Yin Tiger in Zodiac Village.
prerequisites: Unlock Zodiac Village.
guideSteps: Ask Yin Tiger to challenge him; upgrades remain available after the duel.
Defeat him to unlock Ebon Flow and an extra Curio slot.
achievements.routeHint: Challenge and defeat Yin Tiger in Zodiac Village.

achievements.requirementSummary: Give Chen Loong a seed and harvest a plant in Zodiac Village.
prerequisites: Unlock Zodiac Village and obtain any seed while harvesting plants.
guideSteps: Deliver a seed to Chen Loong so he plants it.
Return after the real-time crop cycle and harvest the planted ingredients.
achievements.routeHint: Give Chen Loong a seed and harvest a plant in Zodiac Village.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete the Treasure Hunter quest and defeat Green-Capped Martialist.
guideSteps: Rescue and exhaust the Treasure Hunter's dialogue near North Shore of the Bitter Lake.
Find him shivering near Towers of Karma and cast Ring of Fire beside him.
Reach Melon Field from Brook of Bliss and defeat Green-Capped Martialist.
guideChecklist: Ring of Fire at Towers of Karma
achievements.routeHint: Complete the Treasure Hunter quest and defeat Green-Capped Martialist.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete the Snow Fox quest by defeating Non-Void and reporting back.
guideSteps: Speak to the fox corpse near Forest of Felicity and take the Snow Fox Brush.
Use the brush near Non-Void in New Thunderclap Temple, then defeat him.
Return to the fox corpse to finish the quest and receive Snow Fox Brush Curio.
achievements.routeHint: Complete the Snow Fox quest by defeating Non-Void and reporting back.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat the four Captains and give their spirit remnants to the Pagoda prisoner.
prerequisites: Speak through the locked cell beside Lower Pagoda's starting cell.
guideSteps: Defeat Captain Lotus-Vision below Upper Pagoda.
Defeat Captain Wise-Voice at Mani Wheel.
Defeat Captain Kalpa-Wave before New Thunderclap Temple.
Collect Captain Void-Illusion's remnant from the corpse near Longevity Road.
Return all four remnants to the prisoner at Lower Pagoda.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat the four Captains and give their spirit remnants to the Pagoda prisoner.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Yellowbrow's four named disciples.
guideSteps: Defeat Non-White twice on the Mindfulness Cliff route.
Defeat Non-Able near Brook of Bliss.
Defeat Non-Void during the Snow Fox quest.
Defeat Non-Pure inside New Thunderclap Temple.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Yellowbrow's four named disciples.

achievements.requirementSummary: Win all three Macaque Chief encounters in Chapter 3.
guideSteps: Defeat Macaque Chief at Snowhill Path.
Defeat the second encounter during Chapter 3 progression.
Win the final encounter during Yellowbrow's story sequence.
achievements.routeHint: Win all three Macaque Chief encounters in Chapter 3.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Yellowbrow and finish Chapter 3.
guideSteps: Clear New Thunderclap Temple and enter the main hall.
Complete every phase of the Yellowbrow story battle.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Yellowbrow and finish Chapter 3.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Buddha's Right Hand in Webbed Hollow.
guideSteps: Follow the Webbed Hollow main route to the suspended hand-shaped creature.
Defeat both phases to create the bridge deeper into the hollow.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Buddha's Right Hand in Webbed Hollow.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Zhu Bajie in both Chapter 4 encounters.
guideSteps: Defeat Zhu Bajie in the first Webbed Hollow arena.
Pursue him through the mud route and win the second encounter.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Zhu Bajie in both Chapter 4 encounters.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Violet Spider in Webbed Hollow.
guideSteps: Reach the Estate of Zhu and continue to the Violet Spider arena.
Defeat Violet Spider and escape the webbed cavern sequence.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Violet Spider in Webbed Hollow.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Yellow Loong after completing the earlier Loong fights.
prerequisites: Obtain Loong Scales and defeat Red Loong, Black Loong, and Cyan Loong.
guideSteps: Travel to Webbed Hollow - Relief of the Fallen Loong.
Complete the duel with Yellow Loong to receive Golden Lining and Golden Carp.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Yellow Loong after completing the earlier Loong fights.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Venom Daoist twice and enter Purple Cloud Mountain.
guideSteps: Defeat Venom Daoist at Pool of Shattered Jade.
Find and defeat him again near Court of Illumination.
Pass through the revealed mural to enter Purple Cloud Mountain.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Venom Daoist twice and enter Purple Cloud Mountain.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete Daoist Mi's quest and obtain Violet Hail.
achievements.missableNote: Daoist Mi disappears when Duskveil is defeated. Finish his quest before the secret-area final boss.
prerequisites: Unlock Purple Cloud Mountain.
guideSteps: Speak to Daoist Mi at Petalfall Hamlet.
Farm nearby yellow-robed Daoists until one drops Violet Hailstone.
Return the item and defeat Daoist Mi before fighting Duskveil.
achievements.routeHint: Complete Daoist Mi's quest and obtain Violet Hail.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Scorpionlord and all four smaller scorpion-family enemies in Chapter 4.
achievements.missableNote: Scorpionlord joins the Duskveil fight and becomes unavailable if Duskveil is engaged first. Defeat him before Duskveil.
prerequisites: Unlock Purple Cloud Mountain for Scorpionlord.
guideSteps: Find and defeat the four scorpion princes while exploring Webbed Hollow.
At Purple Cloud Mountain, break Scorpionlord's jars and defeat him before Duskveil.
achievements.routeHint: This achievement tracks two scorpion-family subgoals in Chapter 4. Finish both the Scorpionlord encounter and the Four Scorpion Princes chain before moving on if the game has not already marked it complete.

requirementTargets.name: Scorpionlord
requirementTargets.howToGet: Defeat Scorpionlord in Chapter 4. If he does not appear, revisit the Yellow Flower routes and make sure you have not locked the encounter out.

requirementTargets.name: Four Chapter 4 Scorpion Enemies
requirementTargets.howToGet: Defeat the four smaller Chapter 4 scorpion-family enemies so the save records the second scorpion-family requirement.

missingTargets.name: Scorpionlord
missingTargets.howToGet: Defeat Scorpionlord in Chapter 4. If he does not appear, revisit the Yellow Flower routes and make sure you have not locked the encounter out.

missingTargets.name: Four Chapter 4 Scorpion Enemies
missingTargets.howToGet: Defeat the four smaller Chapter 4 scorpion-family enemies so the save records the second scorpion-family requirement.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Duskveil in Purple Cloud Mountain.
prerequisites: Unlock Purple Cloud Mountain through Venom Daoist.
guideSteps: Finish Daoist Mi and Scorpionlord first so their missable rewards remain available.
Climb to Cloudnest Peak and defeat both phases of Duskveil.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Duskveil in Purple Cloud Mountain.

achievements.requirementSummary: Remove all four purple talismans and survive the Supreme Inspector encounter.
achievements.missableNote: Finish all four talismans before defeating Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master; the quest becomes unavailable afterward.
guideSteps: Remove three purple talismans while descending through Webbed Hollow.
Remove the fourth at Temple of Yellow Flowers - Court of Illumination.
Complete the resulting Supreme Inspector encounter before the chapter boss.
achievements.routeHint: Remove all four purple talismans and survive the Supreme Inspector encounter.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master and finish Chapter 4.
guideSteps: Finish the Purple Talisman quest before entering the final arena.
Use Weaver's Needle to cancel the boss's golden domain, then defeat Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat Hundred-Eyed Daoist Master and finish Chapter 4.

achievements.requirementSummary: Fully upgrade the starting gourd and show it to the old master in Chapter 5.
prerequisites: Collect enough Luojia Fragrant Vines to upgrade the Old Gourd to nine uses.
guideSteps: Ask Shen Monkey to upgrade the starting gourd through every tier.
In Furnace Valley, speak to the old master beside the fire until he upgrades it to Supreme Gourd.
achievements.routeHint: Fully upgrade the starting gourd and show it to the old master in Chapter 5.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat the Keeper of Flaming Mountains and Yin-Yang Fish.
guideSteps: Reach Emerald Hall through Furnace Valley.
Complete the Keeper of Flaming Mountains encounter, including the Yin-Yang Fish phase.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat the Keeper of Flaming Mountains and Yin-Yang Fish.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete Ma Tianba's five-chapter Horse Guai quest and obtain Dark Thunder.
achievements.missableNote: Speak to Ma Tianba in every chapter before completing the Chapter 5 Keeper encounter; skipped dialogue can lock the final reward.
guideSteps: Find Ma Tianba and exhaust his dialogue in Chapters 1, 2, 3, and 4 before moving on.
In Chapter 5, find the cart holding his whip in Furnace Valley.
After the Keeper of Flaming Mountains fight, return and pull the whip to receive Dark Thunder.
achievements.routeHint: Complete Ma Tianba's five-chapter Horse Guai quest and obtain Dark Thunder.

achievements.requirementSummary: Deliver all 12 save-tracked seed items to Chen Loong; together they grow 15 harvestable plant types.
prerequisites: Unlock Zodiac Village.
guideSteps: Harvest plants whenever you pass them; ordinary seed drops are random and plants respawn on a real-time cycle.
Defeat the four plant bosses for their guaranteed specialist seeds.
Give every new seed to Chen Loong. The analyzer's 12-item checklist follows the game's authoritative achievement requirements.
achievements.routeHint: Turn every seed in to Chen Loong in Zodiac Village. Plant seeds are RNG drops with roughly 30-minute respawns, while boss seeds are fixed drops.

achievements.requirementSummary: Defeat every required plant Guai: six named bosses and the four burrowing plant enemy types.
guideSteps: Defeat the six named plant bosses, then kill at least one of each burrowing plant enemy type.
Elder Armourworm's separate Spirit also requires giving Proto-Armourworm to Chen Loong and feeding it three Rice Cocoons.
achievements.routeHint: Defeat every required plant Guai: six named bosses and the four burrowing plant enemy types.

achievements.requirementSummary: Complete Pale-Axe Stalwart's Five Element Carts quest and open Bishui Cave.
guideSteps: Defeat Pale-Axe Stalwart, then exhaust his friendly dialogue.
Defeat the active elemental carts along the Chapter 5 story route and revisit Pale-Axe after each stage.
Return to Cooling Slope, defeat Rusty-Gold Cart, and inspect the frozen gate to Bishui Cave.
achievements.routeHint: Complete Pale-Axe Stalwart's Five Element Carts quest and open Bishui Cave.

achievements.requirementSummary: Find all 24 Meditation Spots: 3 in Chapter 1, 6 in Chapter 2, 5 in Chapter 3, 6 in Chapter 4, and 4 in Chapter 5.
guideSteps: Meditation Spots are one-time map interactions, so sweep them in shrine order before leaving each chapter.
Use the analyzer's 24 save-verified rows to see the exact spot still missing.
guideChecklist: Chapter 1: The Arbor, The Cavern, The Cliff
Chapter 2: The Ravine, The Altar, The Grotto, The Sculpture, The Deadwood, The Rock
Chapter 3: The Shade, The Bottom, The Statue, The Track, The Hall
Chapter 4: The Carvings, The Tree, Cave Depths, The Height, The Pines, The Ledge
Chapter 5: The Buddha, The Relief, The Crag, The Screen
achievements.routeHint: Meditation spots are one-time map pickups. Sweep each chapter in shrine-travel order: Chapter 1 has 3, Chapter 2 has 6, Chapter 3 has 5, Chapter 4 has 6, and Chapter 5 has 4.

achievements.requirementSummary: Collect the 71 armor pieces named by the PC/Xbox achievement data; starter and Deluxe Edition extras are excluded.
achievements.missableNote: Break four of Venom Daoist's rear arms in his first fight for Venomous Armguard, and defeat Scorpionlord before Duskveil for his armor reward.

Farm standalone enemy-drop headgear and armguards, then use the analyzer's 71 exact ownership rows for cleanup.

Standalone pieces: Yin-Yang Daoist Robe, Venomous Armguard, Guanyin's Prayer Beads, Vajra Armguard

achievements.requirementSummary: Craft or obtain all 20 required weapons; three require materials or recipes available in New Game+.
guideSteps: Unlock every weapon tree through story bosses, Loong fights, secret areas, and the true-ending reward.
In New Game+, revisit Fuban/Bishui content and shrine crafting for the three final weapons.
A weapon counts as owned even if a later branch was crafted from it; compare the analyzer's exact 20 rows.
achievements.routeHint: Most weapons come from shrine crafting plus a few boss and quest rewards. Compare this checklist against your shrine craft list first; the usual final holdouts are the two NG+ crafts.
